title: Plus Size Knot Detail Glitter Long Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads at the next wedding in this chic plus-size knit dress! Featuring a flattering knot detail at the waist, this elegant design offers a perfect blend of comfort and sophistication, making it an ideal choice for celebrating love in style.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Fitted sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises knit.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
